jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production modular 2D character cutout atlas. Reference is Hollow Vale Arcane Vanguard style and Bloodblade identity, specifically pale male vampire with slicked black hair, tall crimson collar, burgundy-and-black clothes, gold waist buckle, dark boots, red-lined cape. Generate ONLY his separate body parts, not assembled character. Clean cel-shaded shapes, fine confident dark contours, flat hard shadows. All pieces face the specified viewing direction. Genuine transparent background with alpha. EXACT uniform 3-column by 4-row grid, 12 cells. No text, grid lines, labels, cast shadows, glow or decorations. EACH piece separately isolated and centered with at least 20% transparent cell padding. Do not connect pieces or overlap cells. Fully paint hidden joint overlap to allow rotation. Hands empty; sword separate. Row1: head with black hair and pale neck (no collar); chest torso with tall red collar, vest and belt but no arms, head or legs; long rear crimson-lined dark cape without body. Row2: front coat-tails/pelvis skirt with no legs; anatomical LEFT upper arm shoulder to elbow; anatomical RIGHT upper arm shoulder to elbow. Row3: anatomical LEFT forearm with empty hand elbow to fingers; anatomical RIGHT forearm with empty hand; anatomical LEFT trouser leg hip to ankle without boot. Row4: anatomical RIGHT trouser leg hip to ankle without boot; anatomical LEFT boot; anatomical RIGHT boot. Arms point downward in relaxed neutral pose. Body proportions lean and elegant, not bulky. Portrait canvas. Every cell contains exactly one item. Same character in all directions. DIRECTION: EAST profile, facing right, nose points horizontally right
